item.title: 14k-Mile 1994 Dodge Viper RT/10 Hennessey Venom 550 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1994 Dodge Viper RT/10 spent most of its time registered in Washington state and is believed to have been modified by Hennessey Motorsports in the mid-1990s with the company's Venom 550 package, which modified the 8.0-liter V10 with a revised camshaft, cylinder heads, and exhaust components. The engine is backed by a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.description: This 2004 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra coupe was initially sold in Florida and remained registered in the state through the seller's acquisition in 2025.
